idphoto.mdd: Let me cut it to the official size.
idphoto.bgRule.lightGray: a light grey background is required
idphoto.bgRule.plain: any plain, unpatterned background is fine
idphoto.guide.head: Head height
idphoto.guide.eyeBand: line your eyes up inside the blue band
idphoto.status.idle: Pick a photo, then drag so your eyes sit in the blue band
idphoto.status.ready: Drag to move, use the slider to resize. eyes inside the blue band
idphoto.status.badImage: Could not read that as an image
idphoto.status.sheet: Saved a sheet with {n} photos (cut lines included)
idphoto.note.rules: Faces are not detected automatically. the required position is drawn as guides and you line the photo up. Rules differ slightly between offices, so check their guidance too. The photo never leaves your browser.
idphoto.a11y.canvas: Photo position. arrow keys to move it inside the guides
